meta.scope: Items an Alliance character of any of the nine classes can equip while leveling 1-60: quality 2-5 with reqLvl 1-60, or no reqLvl at any ilvl; plus quality-1 (white) melee weapons, shields, held-in-off-hand items, ranged weapons and relics from the wowsims db under the same level rule. Horde-only items and Horde-only sources removed. Shirts, tabards, cosmetic items, fishing poles and items no class can equip are out of scope.
meta.sameSchemaAs: /home/claude/data/items_forever_all.json (Shaman-only build); every key of that file is kept with the same meaning. New keys: usableBy, equipSlots, weaponSubtype, rangedType; slot gains "Ranged", "Relic (Idol)", "Relic (Libram)"; weaponType gains Sword, Polearm, Bow, Gun, Crossbow, Thrown, Wand, Idol, Libram; ranged weapons carry a weapon block (min/max/speed/dps, plus spellSchool / damageSchoolWowhead on wands); classAllowlistSource marks allowlists read from a Wowhead "Classes:" line.
meta.usableBy: One entry per class that can equip the item on an Alliance character. fromLevel = the level gate from the class rules (Plate 40 for Warrior/Paladin, Mail 40 for Hunter/Shaman, Polearms 20, Dual Wield 10/20 for Off Hand-only weapons); null = no gate. The character can equip it at max(reqLvl, fromLevel). slots = where that class can put it; one-hand weapons list offHand only for dual-wield classes, with offHandFromLevel = the Dual Wield level.
meta.equipSlots: Paper-doll slots the item fits regardless of class: head, neck, shoulder, back, chest, wrist, hands, waist, legs, feet, finger1/finger2, trinket1/trinket2, mainHand, offHand, ranged. Two-Hand weapons list mainHand and block the off hand.

notes.fromLevel: Level gate from DB2 SkillRaceClassInfo.MinLevel for the skill line and class (null = no gate). The character can equip the item at max(item reqLvl, fromLevel).
notes.dualWield: Level at which the class can learn Dual Wield (DB2 SkillRaceClassInfo skill 118); null = cannot dual wield. One-hand weapons go in the off hand only from that level; Off Hand-only weapons need it.
notes.heldInOffHand: Held In Off-hand items are armor subclass 0 (Miscellaneous). No proficiency spell in the DB2 covers that subclass, so every class can hold one.
notes.relics: Idol, Libram and Totem (armor subclasses 8, 7, 9) are granted by proficiency spells 27764 (Druid), 27762 (Paladin), 27763 (Shaman) on the GENERIC (DND) skill line.

clientDB2.method: Proficiency spells = SkillLineAbility spells that have a SpellEquippedItems row and a SpellEffect of type 60 (Proficiency); the classes come from SkillLineAbility.ClassMask (rows with AcquireMethod 3 = never learned are skipped), the item subclasses from SpellEquippedItems.EquippedItemSubclass, and the level gate from SkillRaceClassInfo.MinLevel for the same skill line and class. Dual Wield = skill line 118 / spell 674 (SpellEffect type 40).

warcraftTavernHunterLeveling.confirms: Thrown trainers listed for Hunters (Bixi Wobblebonk, Ilyenia Moonfire); Polearms 20

resolutions.hunterThrown: Allowed. Client DB2 SkillLineAbility spell 2567 (Thrown) has Hunter in its ClassMask and SkillRaceClassInfo row 143 gives Hunter the Thrown skill; Warcraft Tavern lists Thrown for Hunters and names the Thrown trainers. The wowsims capability table leaves Thrown out for Hunters.
resolutions.hunterHeldInOffHand: Allowed. Held In Off-hand items are armor subclass Miscellaneous, and no proficiency spell in the client DB2 covers that subclass, so no class needs a skill for them. The wowsims weapon table lists OffHand for every class except Hunter.
resolutions.shamanDualWield: Not allowed. The only Shaman SkillLineAbility row for Dual Wield (674) has AcquireMethod 3 (never learned); wowsims SpecCanDualWieldCapabilities has no Shaman spec. Off Hand-only weapons are therefore not Shaman-usable.
resolutions.druidPolearms: Allowed from level 20 (Forever change). Client DB2 SkillLineAbility spell 200 includes Druid; SkillRaceClassInfo row 2483 sets MinLevel 20; Warcraft Tavern and wowsims agree.
resolutions.rogueOneHandedAxes: Allowed (Forever change). Client DB2 spell 196 includes Rogue; Warcraft Tavern and wowsims agree.

primarySource.origin: Generated by tools/database/gen_db from the WoW Forever client DB2 tables (product "wowf"), plus AtlasLoot (MoP data) and QuestieDB-Forever for sources

secondarySources.wowhead: https://nether.wowhead.com/forever/tooltip/item/<id> (fetched 2026-11-08; top drop source + drop chance, effect text, set bonuses, cross-check)
secondarySources.warcraftdb: https://forever.warcraftdb.com/api/data/node/item/<id>, /tab/<slug>, /api/data/node/spell/<id> (fetched 2026-11-08; recipe skill, reagents, vendor cost, crowd-sourced drop chance)
secondarySources.clientDB2: https://wago.tools/db2/<Table>/csv?build=1.60.1.70862 (SkillLine, SkillLineAbility, SkillRaceClassInfo, SpellEquippedItems, SpellEffect; class equip rules)
secondarySources.warcraftTavern: https://www.warcrafttavern.com/forever/guides/weapon-trainers/ (fetched 2026-11-08; class x weapon skill table, polearm level)

meta.statKeys: stats use names resolved from proto/common.proto Stat enum. healing = bonus healing; spellDamage = bonus spell damage (all schools). hitRating/critRating/hasteRating are ratings: 10 hit = 1%, 14 crit = 1%, 10 haste = 1% at level 60 (sim/core/base_stats_auto_gen.go). Hit and crit ratings apply to melee, ranged and spells (sim/core/unit.go RatingChannelTable).
meta.supplement: 304 items listed by Warcraft DB Forever but absent from the wowsims db were added from Wowhead Forever tooltips (field dataOrigin marks them). Placeholder ([PH], UNUSED, DEP, Monster) and Horde PvP names skipped. A Wowhead "Classes:" line becomes classAllowlist (classAllowlistSource marks it).

lootSupplementWowtbc.note: Boss and trash drop sources from wowtbc.gg WoW Forever loot tables, matched by item id (and exact name). A source is added only when no drop source with the same npc and dungeon exists; otherwise the existing source gets dungeonLevel / drop chance / provenance. dropChancePct = wowtbc drop_chance x 100 when given (dropChanceSource "wowtbc.gg"), else the Wowhead Forever tooltip or Warcraft DB value for the same npc, else null. dungeonLevel uses Blizzard's official ranges for the nine new Forever dungeons (https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24301455), wowtbc's range otherwise; dungeonLevelWowtbc keeps wowtbc's range where it differs. "other": "Trash" marks trash drops. Items with dataOrigin "wowtbc" are not in the wowsims db or the Warcraft DB crawl; stats mapped from wowtbc keys that were checked against wowsims on overlapping items.

finalize.wowheadNote: wowheadNote copies the Wowhead Forever tooltip line "Added in Season of Discovery. May not be in WoW: Forever." when present; those items may not exist in Forever.
